title: CloudPipe — Registration QC
description: How well each scan was aligned, in two independent steps: the anatomy onto the MNI template (T1w→MNI, non-linear) and each BOLD run onto that participant's own anatomy (BOLD→T1w, rigid). Each step is organised gate-first — what the calibrated gate decided, then the recorded-only metrics behind it, then the rows that need a human. Deduplicated to the most recent attempt per session/run.

query.rawSQL: SELECT DISTINCT subject FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration ORDER BY subject
SELECT DISTINCT session FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration ORDER BY session

list.name: schema_version
list.label: Schema version
list.description: Pin one schema_version before comparing any metric across a long time range. jac_* and log_jac_* were restricted to brain voxels at 2.1, mi was replaced by nmi at 2.1, and the seg_*/ngf families only exist from 2.5 — pooling versions silently mixes definitions.

query.rawSQL: SELECT DISTINCT schema_version FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration ORDER BY schema_version

options.content:
### 🎯 Did the scans line up?

Two independent alignment jobs, gated separately:

- **T1w → MNI** — the participant's anatomy warped onto a standard template. Non-linear, so the gate asks about *warp health*: does it agree with the template (`lncc`), and does it fold (`jac_det_frac_negative`)?
- **BOLD → T1w** — each run aligned to that participant's own anatomy. Rigid, so the gate asks *did the transform beat doing nothing*.

Each section leads with **what the gate decided**, then the recorded-only metrics behind it. Rejected steps did not promote their outputs.

**Two traps.** ① *NMI near 1.0 is not a failure* — doing nothing already scores ~1.011 and a good run ~1.018, which is why `nmi_gain` (`nmi` − `nmi_identity`) is the gated quantity. ② *A large transform is not a bad transform* — BOLD is never resampled out of native scanner space, so a 16–130 mm offset is field-of-view prescription. Nothing gates on it.

🟢🟡🔴 = a calibrated bound exists · 🔵 = descriptive only. Colour bands come from the measured passing distribution, not from round numbers.

panels.title: Anatomicals registered
panels.description: Sessions with a T1w→MNI record in range, counted once per session even if it was reprocessed.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_sessions FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni'

panels.title: BOLD runs registered
panels.description: BOLD runs with a BOLD→T1w record in range, counted once per run even if it was reprocessed.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_runs FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w'

panels.title: Anatomicals rejected
panels.description: Share of evaluated sessions whose composite T1w→MNI verdict is not `pass`. This gate is calibrated and it fails the step before outputs are promoted, so a rejected session did not proceed. Bounds live in _T1W_MNI_THRESHOLDS in images/shared/registration_qc.py. Sessions with an empty verdict (the early-exit failure path) are excluded from both sides of the ratio — those are crashes rather than rejections and belong on the Failure Triage board.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN verdict IN ('fail', 'warn') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pct_rejected FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND verdict IS NOT NULL AND verdict <> ''

panels.title: BOLD runs rejected
panels.description: Share of evaluated BOLD runs whose verdict is not `pass`. The BOLD→T1w gate is a single structural floor — nmi_gain <= 0, meaning the transform did no better than identity — so this reads as 'the registration did something', not 'the registration is good'. Read it beside the NMI-gain spread below.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN verdict IN ('fail', 'warn') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pct_rejected FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND verdict IS NOT NULL AND verdict <> ''

panels.title: 🧠 Anatomy → template (T1w → MNI) — what the gate decided
Intensity agreement (LNCC)
panels.description: Mean local normalized cross-correlation inside the MNI brain mask — the single most discriminating T1w→MNI metric, and the reason the other gates add so little. An individual T1w against an *average* template caps diffeomorphically around 0.83, so the bands are set from the measured passing distribution (median 0.78) rather than from 1.0: green above 0.72, yellow in the 0.65–0.72 approach zone, red below the 0.65 fail bound.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(lncc), 3) AS mean_lncc FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND lncc IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Sessions failing on LNCC
panels.description: Share of sessions below the 0.65 LNCC fail bound. Broken registrations score around 0.19 here, so this fires on gross failure rather than on marginal quality — 0.65 sits far below the healthy mean and far above the broken anchor.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN lncc < 0.65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(lncc), 0), 1) AS pct_below FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni'

panels.title: Sessions over the folding budget
panels.description: Share of sessions where more than 0.5% of brain voxels have a negative Jacobian determinant — the warp turned space inside out locally. The second of the two gated failure families, independent of LNCC. The budget sits above the healthy distribution deliberately: the previous 0.001 bound sat inside it and tripped ~17% of normal registrations, measuring the population mean rather than detecting anomalies.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN jac_det_frac_negative > 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(jac_det_frac_negative), 0), 1) AS pct_folded FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni'

panels.title: Intensity agreement (LNCC) — spread across sessions
panels.description: One observation per session. The threshold line is the 0.65 fail bound, not an ideal — healthy sessions bunch in the high 0.7s because that is the diffeomorphic ceiling against an average template. The feature to look for is separation: a tight healthy cluster with a few points far to its left, rather than a smear running down to the bound.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT lncc FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND lncc IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Warp folding — spread across sessions
panels.description: Fraction of brain voxels where the warp folded, per session. Folding is a failure family rather than a matter of degree, so the shape to look for is a spike near zero with nothing to the right of the 0.005 line.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT jac_det_frac_negative FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND jac_det_frac_negative IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 🧠 Anatomy → template — warp shape and position (recorded, not gated)
Brain-mask overlap (Dice)
panels.description: Overlap between the warped brain mask and the MNI reference mask. Deliberately NOT gated: whole-brain overlap saturates for affine+SyN to a template, so any bound that can fire at all sits far below the achievable floor and only catches registrations LNCC has already rejected. Bands come from the measured passing range (0.955–0.980).

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(mask_dice), 4) AS mean_mask_dice FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND mask_dice IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Volume change (mean Jacobian)
panels.description: Mean Jacobian determinant of the warp: 1.0 preserves volume on average, above 1 expands, below 1 compresses. Descriptive only, and NOT poolable across the schema 2.0/2.1 boundary — 2.1 restricted every jac_* field to brain voxels where 2.0 included unconstrained background extrapolation. Pin the Schema version variable before comparing.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(jac_det_mean), 3) AS mean_jac FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND jac_det_mean IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Centre-of-mass shift
panels.description: Median distance the brain's centroid moved once the warp was applied. Unlike the BOLD→T1w offsets in the intro this IS informative — both images are anatomy headed for the same space. Not gated: it is a strict subset of what LNCC and the folding gate already see. Bands come from the measured passing range (median 0.35 mm, max 1.1 mm), so yellow already means unusual.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(centroid_displacement_mm, 0.5), 2) AS median_shift FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND centroid_displacement_mm IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Extreme local volume change
panels.description: Median fraction of voxels with |log det J| > 1.5 — a local volume change beyond about 4.5x. log(det J) is used rather than det J because it is symmetric about zero, making a doubling and a halving comparable. Mass out here usually means failed skull-stripping or anatomy the template cannot accommodate. Uncoloured on purpose: recorded only, with no calibrated bound, and the whole measured range sits inside a single band — colouring it would imply a threshold that does not exist.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(log_jac_frac_beyond_1p5, 0.5), 5) AS median_frac FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND log_jac_frac_beyond_1p5 IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Brain-mask overlap (Dice) — spread across sessions
panels.description: One observation per session. The distribution is narrow by construction, which is exactly why this is not gated — the useful reading is the left tail, not the centre. A passing verdict does not guarantee a good value here.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT mask_dice FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND mask_dice IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Extreme local volume change — spread across sessions
panels.description: Fraction of non-folded brain voxels with |log det J| > 1.5, per session. Folded voxels have no logarithm and are excluded here — they are counted by the folding gate instead, so this denominator is non-folded voxels only. Sessions on the right edge are warping hard to force an intensity match, which is worth seeing even though nothing gates on it. Uncoloured: no calibrated bound exists.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT log_jac_frac_beyond_1p5 FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND log_jac_frac_beyond_1p5 IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Every T1w→MNI metric — coverage and distribution
panels.description: Every column the registration table declares for t1w_to_mni, whether or not a panel above plots it, so nothing recorded is invisible here. `n_measured` against `n_records` is as much the point as the percentiles: a metric reading `not emitted` is being written as null, and if it were ever gated that gate would be failing open — verdict() skips absent keys. That is exactly how `ice_mean_mm` gated nothing from 2026-07-23 to 2026-08-11, and why the ice_* rows now read `not measurable`: they need the inverse of the SyN fit, which fireants cannot produce. Pin the Schema version variable before reading jac_* or log_jac_* — they changed meaning at 2.1.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)), t AS (SELECT * FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni'), m AS (SELECT 1 AS sort_key, 'lncc' AS metric, 'gated · fail < 0.65' AS gate, lncc AS v FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'jac_det_frac_negative', 'gated · fail > 0.005', jac_det_frac_negative FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'ice_mean_mm', 'not measurable', ice_mean_mm FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'mask_dice', 'recorded only', mask_dice FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'centroid_displacement_mm', 'recorded only', centroid_displacement_mm FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'jac_det_min', 'recorded only', jac_det_min FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'jac_det_max', 'recorded only', jac_det_max FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'jac_det_mean', 'recorded only', jac_det_mean FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'jac_det_std', 'recorded only', jac_det_std FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'log_jac_mean', 'recorded only', log_jac_mean FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'log_jac_std', 'recorded only', log_jac_std FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'log_jac_p01', 'recorded only', log_jac_p01 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 13, 'log_jac_p99', 'recorded only', log_jac_p99 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 14, 'log_jac_min', 'recorded only', log_jac_min FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 15, 'log_jac_max', 'recorded only', log_jac_max FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 16, 'log_jac_frac_beyond_1p5', 'recorded only', log_jac_frac_beyond_1p5 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 17, 'log_jac_frac_beyond_3', 'recorded only', log_jac_frac_beyond_3 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 18, 'ice_p95_mm', 'not measurable', ice_p95_mm FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 19, 'ice_p99_mm', 'not measurable', ice_p99_mm FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'ice_max_mm', 'not measurable', ice_max_mm FROM t) SELECT sort_key, metric, gate, COUNT(*) AS n_records, COUNT(v) AS n_measured, ROUND(MIN(v), 5) AS min_v, ROUND(approx_percentile(v, 0.05), 5) AS p05, ROUND(approx_percentile(v, 0.5), 5) AS median, ROUND(approx_percentile(v, 0.95), 5) AS p95, ROUND(MAX(v), 5) AS max_v, ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(v), 5) AS sd FROM m GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🌊 BOLD → anatomy (BOLD → T1w) — what the gate decided
Gain over doing nothing (NMI gain)
panels.description: Median nmi_gain = nmi − nmi_identity: how much normalized mutual information the fitted transform bought over resampling the same BOLD reference with no transform. THE gated metric for BOLD→T1w. Median rather than mean because the failing tail is small and negative and would otherwise be diluted away. Anything at or below 0 fails.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(nmi_gain, 0.5), 5) AS median_gain FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND nmi > 0 AND nmi_gain IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Runs failing the gate
panels.description: Share of runs where the fitted transform did no better than leaving the run where it started. Computed from nmi_gain directly rather than from `verdict`, so it also covers records written before the BOLD→T1w verdict existed; on current data the two agree exactly.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN nmi_gain <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(nmi_gain), 0), 1) AS pct_failed FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w'

panels.title: Absolute agreement (NMI)
panels.description: Studholme normalized MI between the warped BOLD reference and the T1w, inside the brain mask. Uncalibrated and deliberately uncoloured — compare it to the identity baseline beside it, not to 1.0 or 2.0. The whole usable range here is about 1.011–1.020, because nmi pools every brain voxel into one joint histogram and dilutes the alignment signal.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(nmi), 4) AS mean_nmi FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND nmi > 0

panels.title: Identity baseline (NMI)
panels.description: The same NMI computed with NO transform applied — the score for doing nothing. Shown beside absolute NMI so the pair makes the arithmetic visible: the gap between these two numbers is the entire signal, and it is roughly a third of a percent. The baseline itself varies across sessions by about the size of the gain, which is why absolute NMI is not comparable between sessions and is not gated.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(nmi_identity), 4) AS mean_nmi_identity FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND nmi_identity > 0

panels.title: What the alignment bought (NMI gain) — spread across runs
panels.description: One observation per run, with the fail bound at zero. This is the meaningful quantity rather than raw NMI, because subtracting the identity baseline cancels the large constant offset that makes absolute NMI so easy to misread. Anything left of the line is a rejected run.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT nmi_gain FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND nmi_gain IS NOT NULL AND nmi > 0

panels.title: By task and run — coverage and rejections
panels.description: Rejections split by acquisition rather than pooled. A gate failure concentrated in one task or one run index points at the acquisition — first-run prescription, a task with less brain coverage — rather than at the registration code, and that distinction changes who fixes it. `runs` doubles as a coverage check against the expected run count per task.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT task, run, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN nmi_gain <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, ROUND(approx_percentile(CASE WHEN nmi > 0 THEN nmi_gain END, 0.5), 5) AS median_nmi_gain, ROUND(approx_percentile(CASE WHEN seg_bbr_contrast > -999 THEN seg_bbr_contrast END, 0.5), 4) AS median_seg_bbr_contrast FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' GROUP BY task, run ORDER BY task, run

panels.title: 🌊 BOLD → anatomy — boundary agreement and magnitude (recorded, not gated)
Boundary GM/WM contrast
panels.description: Median (mean_GM − mean_WM) / mean in the WM/GM shell, sampling the warped BOLD through FastSurfer's aseg — BBR's premise measured rather than optimised. Phase A found this the strongest of seven candidates against a known 2 mm misregistration (AUC 0.830). Still NOT gated, because it only discriminates when normalised within session; see the within-session table below. Its sentinel is −999, not 0 — a zero here is a real measurement meaning the tissues are indistinguishable.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(seg_bbr_contrast, 0.5), 4) AS median_seg FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND seg_bbr_contrast > -999

panels.title: Gradient-direction agreement (NGF)
panels.description: Median squared cosine between BOLD and T1w intensity-gradient directions on T1w edges, weighted by edge strength. In [0, 1], higher better; squaring makes it blind to the EPI↔T1w polarity flip, as MI is. Second-strongest Phase A candidate (AUC 0.805). Its 0.0 is both the natural floor and the 'no evaluation voxels' sentinel, so it is filtered on > 0.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(ngf, 0.5), 3) AS median_ngf FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND ngf > 0

panels.title: Surface distance (MHD)
panels.description: Median modified Hausdorff distance between the T1w brain surface and an Otsu skull-strip of the warped BOLD. Boundary agreement, orthogonal to intensity agreement — but its floor is set by the soft EPI skull-strip rather than by the registration, which makes it the least trustworthy of these to gate. −1.0 is the could-not-compute sentinel and is excluded.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(mhd_mm, 0.5), 2) AS median_mhd FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND mhd_mm >= 0

panels.title: Worst-voxel displacement
panels.description: Median worst-case brain-voxel displacement induced by the rigid transform. READ THIS AS GEOMETRY, NOT QUALITY. It gated briefly at schema 2.3 and was reverted: ABCD ships the BOLD in original scanner space with a registration matrix alongside, so the BOLD↔T1w offset is field-of-view prescription and routinely tens of millimetres. Values past 100 mm are normal here and are not a defect.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile(rigid_disp_max_mm, 0.5), 1) AS median_disp FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND rigid_disp_max_mm > 0

panels.title: Boundary GM/WM contrast — spread across runs
panels.description: One observation per run. Uncoloured on purpose: no absolute bound is supportable, because between-session variance swamps within-session variance by roughly 14x — the spread here is mostly participants differing from each other, not registrations differing in quality. The within-session table below is where this metric earns its keep.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT seg_bbr_contrast FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND seg_bbr_contrast > -999

panels.title: Gradient-direction agreement (NGF) — spread across runs
panels.description: One observation per run. Same caveat as boundary contrast: informative in relative terms, uncalibrated in absolute ones, so no bands are drawn. A bimodal shape here would be worth chasing — it would mean two populations of runs, which a single summary statistic would not reveal.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT ngf FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND ngf > 0

panels.title: Every BOLD→T1w metric — coverage and distribution
panels.description: Every column the registration table declares for bold_to_t1w, with each sentinel excluded the way the emitter intends (nmi > 0, seg_* > −999, mhd_mm >= 0, ngf > 0) — so `n_measured` below `n_records` means genuinely unmeasured rather than merely sentinel-valued. `mi` and the `rigid_*` trio are here for completeness: `mi` was superseded at schema 2.1 because raw MI inflates as brain overlap collapses, letting a broken registration out-score a healthy one.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)), t AS (SELECT * FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w'), m AS (SELECT 1 AS sort_key, 'nmi_gain' AS metric, 'gated · fail <= 0' AS gate, CASE WHEN nmi > 0 THEN nmi_gain END AS v FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'nmi', 'recorded only', CASE WHEN nmi > 0 THEN nmi END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'nmi_identity', 'recorded only', CASE WHEN nmi_identity > 0 THEN nmi_identity END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'seg_bbr_contrast', 'recorded · best candidate', CASE WHEN seg_bbr_contrast > -999 THEN seg_bbr_contrast END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'seg_bbr_contrast_identity', 'recorded only', CASE WHEN seg_bbr_contrast_identity > -999 THEN seg_bbr_contrast_identity END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'ngf', 'recorded only', CASE WHEN ngf > 0 THEN ngf END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'ngf_identity', 'recorded only', CASE WHEN ngf_identity > 0 THEN ngf_identity END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'mhd_mm', 'recorded only', CASE WHEN mhd_mm >= 0 THEN mhd_mm END FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'rigid_disp_mean_mm', 'recorded · FOV, not quality', rigid_disp_mean_mm FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'rigid_disp_max_mm', 'recorded · FOV, not quality', rigid_disp_max_mm FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'rigid_rot_deg', 'recorded · FOV, not quality', rigid_rot_deg FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'mi', 'superseded at schema 2.1', CASE WHEN mi > 0 THEN mi END FROM t) SELECT sort_key, metric, gate, COUNT(*) AS n_records, COUNT(v) AS n_measured, ROUND(MIN(v), 5) AS min_v, ROUND(approx_percentile(v, 0.05), 5) AS p05, ROUND(approx_percentile(v, 0.5), 5) AS median, ROUND(approx_percentile(v, 0.95), 5) AS p95, ROUND(MAX(v), 5) AS max_v, ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(v), 5) AS sd FROM m GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Anatomicals the gate rejected
panels.description: One row per rejected session, worst LNCC first. `gate_fired` names every bound the record crossed and its value, so a rejection can be judged without opening Athena; an empty `gate_fired` beside a `fail` verdict means the record crossed a bound this panel does not know about, which is itself the signal that the threshold table changed and this SQL did not. These sessions did not promote outputs and need resubmitting. Empty is the good outcome.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT subject, session, verdict, array_join(filter(ARRAY[CASE WHEN lncc < 0.65 THEN format('lncc %.3f < 0.65', lncc) END, CASE WHEN jac_det_frac_negative > 0.005 THEN format('folding %.4f > 0.005', jac_det_frac_negative) END], x -> x IS NOT NULL), ' + ') AS gate_fired, ROUND(lncc, 3) AS lncc, ROUND(jac_det_frac_negative, 6) AS folding, ROUND(mask_dice, 4) AS mask_dice, ROUND(centroid_displacement_mm, 2) AS centroid_mm, schema_version, completed_at FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 't1w_to_mni' AND verdict IN ('fail', 'warn') ORDER BY lncc LIMIT 100

panels.title: BOLD runs the gate rejected
panels.description: One row per rejected run, worst gain first. The recorded-only columns are carried along as context: a run that fails nmi_gain while its boundary contrast looks like its siblings' is a different story from one where every metric agrees it is broken. Filtered on the verdict OR on nmi_gain directly, so records written before the BOLD→T1w verdict existed still appear.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT subject, session, task, run, verdict, array_join(filter(ARRAY[CASE WHEN nmi_gain <= 0 THEN format('nmi_gain %.5f <= 0', nmi_gain) END], x -> x IS NOT NULL), ' + ') AS gate_fired, ROUND(nmi, 4) AS nmi, ROUND(nmi_identity, 4) AS nmi_identity, ROUND(nmi_gain, 5) AS nmi_gain, ROUND(seg_bbr_contrast, 4) AS seg_bbr_contrast, ROUND(ngf, 3) AS ngf, ROUND(mhd_mm, 2) AS mhd_mm, schema_version, completed_at FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND (verdict IN ('fail', 'warn') OR nmi_gain <= 0) ORDER BY nmi_gain LIMIT 100

panels.title: Runs that stand out within their own session
panels.description:
A triage aid, NOT a gate — nothing here rejected anything. Boundary contrast is the strongest available signal but only within a session, for two reasons that both cancel here: the between-session spread is dominated by field-of-view prescription, and every run in a session shares one aseg so segmentation error cancels too. Each row is a run whose contrast falls at least 0.020 below its own session's MEDIAN, in sessions with at least 3 runs. Deliberately not a z-score: a sample z is bounded by (n−1)/√n, which is only 2.04 for a 6-run session and 1.15 for a 3-run one, so any SD-based cut is either unreachable for small sessions or fires on a fixed ~7% of large ones by chance. The 0.020 gap is the measured 1st percentile of within-session deviations (~1% of runs). A run listed here whose nmi_gain still passed is the case worth opening by eye.

One confound to read past: a session is typically 4 rest runs and 2 nback, so the median is set by rest and the nback pair can sit below it for acquisition reasons rather than registration ones. The tell is BOTH siblings of a task appearing together — a registration defect hits one run, an acquisition property hits the pair. Partitioning the median by task would not fix this: with only 2 nback runs their median is their mean, so a pair-wide offset becomes invisible.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)), b AS (SELECT subject, session, task, run, verdict, seg_bbr_contrast, ngf, nmi_gain FROM d WHERE rn = 1 AND registration_type = 'bold_to_t1w' AND seg_bbr_contrast > -999), z AS (SELECT *, approx_percentile(seg_bbr_contrast, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session) AS s_median, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session) AS n_runs FROM b) SELECT subject, session, task, run, verdict, ROUND(seg_bbr_contrast, 4) AS seg_bbr_contrast, ROUND(s_median, 4) AS session_median, ROUND(seg_bbr_contrast - s_median, 4) AS gap_from_median, n_runs, ROUND(nmi_gain, 5) AS nmi_gain, ROUND(ngf, 3) AS ngf FROM z WHERE n_runs >= 3 AND seg_bbr_contrast - s_median <= -0.020 ORDER BY 8 LIMIT 100

panels.title: 📦 Provenance — what is actually in range
Records by registration type and schema version
panels.description: Read this first when a number above looks wrong. More than one schema_version per registration type means the panels above are pooling records whose metrics do not mean the same thing — jac_* and log_jac_* were restricted to brain voxels at 2.1, `mi` was replaced by `nmi` at 2.1, and the seg_*/ngf families only exist from 2.5. Use the Schema version variable at the top to pin one. The dt range also shows whether the time filter is catching the batch you think it is: QC records partition on the day the step finished, so a batch spanning midnight UTC lands in two partitions.

targets.rawSQL: WITH d AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subject, session, registration_type, task, run ORDER BY completed_at DESC) AS rn FROM cloudpipe_metrics.registration WHERE ('${subject}' = 'All' OR subject = '${subject}') AND ('${session}' = 'All' OR session = '${session}') AND ('${schema_version}' = 'All' OR schema_version = '${schema_version}') AND from_iso8601_timestamp(completed_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND CAST(dt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom() AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo() AS DATE)) SELECT registration_type, schema_version, pipeline, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT subject) AS subjects, COUNT(DISTINCT subject || '/' || session) AS sessions, MIN(dt) AS first_dt, MAX(dt) AS last_dt, MIN(completed_at) AS first_completed, MAX(completed_at) AS last_completed FROM d WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2
